## Summary

Explain what changed and why.

## Testing

List the checks you ran and any relevant environment details.

## Impact

Describe user-visible, compatibility, packaging, documentation, or security
impact. Write “None” where a category does not apply.

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept this pull request focused on one coherent change.
- [ ] I added or updated tests where behavior changed.
- [ ] I updated documentation and the changelog where appropriate.
- [ ] I used only sanitized, redistributable fixtures and screenshots.
- [ ] I reviewed the complete diff and can explain every submitted change.
